page.title: 条件の範囲を広げる・絞る

analysis.summaryJa: このページは、条件表現を結果が有効になる『範囲の設計』として整理する。even ifは極端な条件まで範囲を広げても結論を変えず、only ifは必要条件へ絞り、unlessは原則から例外を切り出し、provided/providing thatは許可に厳密な境界を置く。また動詞後のif/whetherは条件ではなく『〜かどうか』という真偽内容になる点を区別する。
grammarPoints: even ifは極端な条件でも主節の結論が変わらないこと
動詞後のwhether/ifは『〜かどうか』という内容節になること
only ifは結果成立に必要な条件を示すこと
unlessは『〜しない限り／〜の場合を除いて』を表すこと
provided/providing thatは許可や合意に厳密な条件を付けること
条件表現ごとに主節が有効になる範囲が異なること
visualEvidence: EVENの標識が条件範囲を外側へ広げている
ONLY IFの柵が通過できる条件を一つに絞っている
UNLESSの境界が原則から例外だけを切り出している
PROVIDEDのゲートが許可前に満たす条件を示している
if/whetherの真偽カードが条件ルートとは別に配置されている
commonTraps: even ifをonly ifと取り違えて必要条件にする
whether節を常に条件節として読む
only ifの必要条件と十分条件を逆にする
unlessの中に不要なnotを重ねて二重否定にする
provided thatを理由表現として読む
許可条件が満たされなくても主節が成立すると誤解する

questions.prompt: ------- the client rejects the first draft, we will continue with the research phase.

choices.A: Only if
choices.B: Unless
choices.C: Even if
choices.D: Whether

questions.translationJa: たとえ顧客が初稿を却下しても、私たちは調査段階を続けます。
questions.explanationJa: 極端な条件が起きても主節の結論が変わらないためEven ifが適切です。

questions.prompt: I do not know ------- the maintenance team has finished the inspection.

choices.A: whether
choices.B: unless
choices.C: provided that
choices.D: even if

questions.translationJa: 保守チームが検査を終えたかどうか、私は知りません。
questions.explanationJa: knowの目的語として真偽を尋ねる名詞節なのでwhetherを用います。

questions.prompt: Employees may enter the laboratory ------- they have completed the safety course.

choices.A: even if
choices.B: unless
choices.C: whether
choices.D: only if

questions.translationJa: 従業員は安全講習を修了した場合に限り、研究室へ入れます。
questions.explanationJa: 講習修了が入室に必要な条件であるためonly ifです。

questions.prompt: The warehouse will remain closed ------- the ventilation system passes the test.

choices.A: whether
choices.B: unless
choices.C: even if
choices.D: provided that

questions.translationJa: 換気システムが検査に合格しない限り、倉庫は閉鎖されたままです。
questions.explanationJa: unlessは『〜しない限り』を表し、合格が例外条件になります。

questions.prompt: You may use the company vehicle ------- you return it with a full tank.

choices.A: provided that
choices.B: even if
choices.C: whether
choices.D: unless

questions.translationJa: 満タンにして返すという条件で、社用車を利用できます。
questions.explanationJa: 許可に付ける厳密な条件なのでprovided thatが最適です。

questions.prompt: ------- demand falls sharply, the factory will keep the weekend shift this month.

choices.A: Only if
choices.B: Unless
choices.C: Even if
choices.D: Whether

questions.translationJa: たとえ需要が急減しても、工場は今月の週末シフトを維持します。
questions.explanationJa: 需要減という強い条件でも結論が変わらないことをEven ifで示します。
questions.focus: 極端条件でも結果不変

questions.prompt: Please confirm ------- the invoice includes the revised tax rate.

choices.A: unless
choices.B: whether
choices.C: only if
choices.D: even if

questions.translationJa: 請求書に改訂後の税率が含まれているかどうか確認してください。
questions.explanationJa: confirmの内容として二者の真偽を示すためwhetherです。

questions.prompt: A refund will be issued ------- the item is returned within thirty days.

choices.A: even if
choices.B: unless
choices.C: whether
choices.D: only if

questions.translationJa: 商品が30日以内に返品された場合に限り、返金されます。
questions.explanationJa: 期限内返品が返金の必要条件なのでonly ifを選びます。

questions.prompt: Do not disclose the password ------- a verified administrator requests it.

choices.A: whether
choices.B: even if
choices.C: unless
choices.D: only if

questions.translationJa: 確認済みの管理者から求められた場合を除き、パスワードを開示しないでください。
questions.explanationJa: 開示しない原則から唯一の例外を示すunlessです。

questions.prompt: The supplier can revise the schedule, ------- that all customers are notified in advance.

choices.A: whether
choices.B: providing
choices.C: even
choices.D: unless

questions.translationJa: すべての顧客へ事前通知するという条件で、仕入先は日程を変更できます。
questions.explanationJa: providing thatはprovided thatと同様、許可に厳密な条件を付けます。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence showing an unchanged result.

choices.A: Even if the venue will change, our registration remains valid.
choices.B: Even if the venue changes, our registration remains valid.
choices.C: Unless the venue changes, but our registration remains valid.
choices.D: Whether the venue changes, our registration remains valid even.

questions.translationJa: 会場が変わっても、私たちの登録は有効なままです。
questions.explanationJa: Even ifは条件が変わっても結論が不変であることを示します。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence meaning “whether or not.”

choices.A: We need to determine unless the replacement is compatible.
choices.B: We need to determine provided the replacement is compatible or not condition.
choices.C: We need determine even if the replacement compatible.
choices.D: We need to determine whether the replacement is compatible.

questions.translationJa: 交換品に互換性があるかどうか判断する必要があります。
questions.explanationJa: determineの目的語にはwhether節を置けます。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence stating a necessary condition.

choices.A: The discount applies only if payment is made online.
choices.B: The discount applies even if payment is made online only condition.
choices.C: The discount applies unless payment is made online only.
choices.D: The discount applies whether payment is made online.

questions.translationJa: オンラインで支払った場合に限り割引が適用されます。
questions.explanationJa: only ifがオンライン支払いを必要条件にします。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence using unless.

choices.A: The meeting will proceed unless the chairperson will cancel it.
choices.B: The meeting will proceed unless if the chairperson cancels it.
choices.C: The meeting will proceed unless the chairperson cancels it.
choices.D: The meeting will proceed whether the chairperson cancels it unless.

questions.translationJa: 議長が中止しない限り、会議は行われます。
questions.explanationJa: unlessの後は通常の現在形cancelsを使います。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence imposing a strict condition.

choices.A: Contractors may access the files provided they will sign that the confidentiality agreement.
choices.B: Contractors may access the files even if they do not sign the confidentiality agreement condition.
choices.C: Contractors may access the files whether signing the confidentiality agreement provided.
choices.D: Contractors may access the files provided that they sign the confidentiality agreement.

questions.translationJa: 守秘契約に署名するという条件で、請負業者はファイルへアクセスできます。
questions.explanationJa: provided thatが許可の厳密な条件を示します。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence about an extreme condition.

choices.A: Even the delivery if is late, the launch date will not change.
choices.B: Even if the delivery is late, the launch date will not change.
choices.C: Only if the delivery is late, but the launch date will not change.
choices.D: Unless the delivery is late, the launch date will not change even.

questions.translationJa: 配送が遅れても、発売日は変わりません。
questions.explanationJa: Even ifで望ましくない条件でも結果不変を表します。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence with whether after a verb.

choices.A: Please check whether the conference link is active.
choices.B: Please check unless the conference link is active.
choices.C: Please check provided that the conference link active.
choices.D: Please check even if the conference link is active or condition.

questions.translationJa: 会議リンクが有効かどうか確認してください。
questions.explanationJa: checkの後のwhetherが真偽確認を表します。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence with only if.

choices.A: Visitors receive a badge even if they present identification only.
choices.B: Visitors receive a badge unless they present identification.
choices.C: Visitors receive a badge only if they present identification.
choices.D: Visitors receive only if a badge they present identification.

questions.translationJa: 身分証明書を提示した場合に限り、来訪者はバッジを受け取ります。
questions.explanationJa: only ifで必要条件を明示しています。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence avoiding a double negative with unless.

choices.A: The printer will not start unless the cover is not closed.
choices.B: The printer will not start unless if the cover is closed.
choices.C: The printer will not start whether the cover is closed unless.
choices.D: The printer will not start unless the cover is closed.

questions.translationJa: カバーが閉じていない限り、プリンターは起動しません。
questions.explanationJa: unless自体に否定範囲があるため不要なnotを重ねません。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct formal permission condition.

choices.A: You may reproduce the chart, providing that the source is credited.
choices.B: You may reproduce the chart, providing the source will credited that.
choices.C: You may reproduce the chart, unless the source is credited condition.
choices.D: You may reproduce the chart, whether the source credited providing.

questions.translationJa: 出典を明記するという条件で、その図表を転載できます。
questions.explanationJa: providing thatが改まった許可条件を作ります。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "Even if the price rises, we will renew the service."

choices.A: The service will be renewed only when the price falls.
choices.B: The price cannot rise after the service is renewed.
choices.C: Renewal is impossible because the price may change.
choices.D: A price increase will not change the decision to renew the service.

questions.translationJa: 価格が上がっても、サービス更新の決定は変わりません。
questions.explanationJa: even ifの条件は主節の決定を変えません。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "I wonder whether the branch is open on Saturday."

choices.A: The branch may open only after Saturday.
choices.B: I am uncertain if the branch is open on Saturday.
choices.C: I will visit the branch unless it opens.
choices.D: The branch is definitely closed every Saturday.

questions.translationJa: 支店が土曜日に開いているかどうか不明です。
questions.explanationJa: whetherは真偽の不確かさを表します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "You may enter only if your name is on the list."

choices.A: Everyone may enter regardless of the list.
choices.B: Entry is required before names can be listed.
choices.C: Having your name on the list is necessary for entry.
choices.D: Being absent from the list guarantees entry.

questions.translationJa: 名簿に名前があることが入場に必要です。
questions.explanationJa: only ifが必要条件を示します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "We will not ship the order unless payment arrives."

choices.A: We will ship the order only if payment arrives.
choices.B: We will ship before any payment is made.
choices.C: Payment prevents the order from being shipped.
choices.D: The order has already shipped without payment.

questions.translationJa: 支払いが届いた場合に限り注文を発送します。
questions.explanationJa: not ... unlessはonly ifへ言い換えられます。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "You can work remotely provided that your manager approves."

choices.A: Remote work is allowed even when the manager refuses.
choices.B: Managerial approval is a strict condition for remote work.
choices.C: Approval is needed only after remote work ends.
choices.D: The manager must work remotely instead.

questions.translationJa: 上司の承認が在宅勤務の厳密な条件です。
questions.explanationJa: provided thatは許可条件を明示します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "Even if attendance doubles, the hall can accommodate everyone."

choices.A: The hall is available only when attendance is cut in half.
choices.B: Attendance must double before anyone enters.
choices.C: The hall cannot accommodate the current audience.
choices.D: The hall has enough capacity despite a possible doubling of attendance.

questions.translationJa: 参加者が倍増しても会場には全員を収容できます。
questions.explanationJa: Even ifは極端な条件でも能力が変わらないことを示します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "Please tell me whether the package has arrived."

choices.A: Please tell me if it is true or not that the package has arrived.
choices.B: Please arrange for the package to arrive immediately.
choices.C: Do not tell me after the package arrives.
choices.D: The package will arrive only if I ask.

questions.translationJa: 荷物が到着したか否かを教えてください。
questions.explanationJa: whether節は『〜かどうか』の内容を表します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "The warranty is valid only if the seal remains intact."

choices.A: Breaking the seal extends the warranty.
choices.B: The warranty remains valid regardless of the seal.
choices.C: An intact seal is required for the warranty to be valid.
choices.D: The seal can be removed only after the warranty is renewed.

questions.translationJa: 封印が無傷であることが保証の有効条件です。
questions.explanationJa: only ifは保証成立の必要条件です。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "Do not contact the director unless the matter is urgent."

choices.A: Contact the director about every routine matter.
choices.B: Contact the director only when the matter is urgent.
choices.C: Urgent matters must never reach the director.
choices.D: The director will contact you unless there is an emergency.

questions.translationJa: 緊急の場合に限って取締役へ連絡してください。
questions.explanationJa: not ... unlessは『例外の場合だけ』を意味します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "The data may be shared, provided that all names are removed."

choices.A: Sharing the data requires adding more names.
choices.B: The data may never be shared under any condition.
choices.C: Removing every name is a condition for permission to share the data.
choices.D: Names can be removed only after publication.

questions.translationJa: 全ての氏名削除がデータ共有許可の条件です。
questions.explanationJa: provided thatで共有の厳密な前提を示します。

questions.prompt: The conference will be held as scheduled. ------- the keynote speaker cancels, the panel discussion will continue.

choices.A: Even if
choices.B: Only if
choices.C: Unless
choices.D: Whether

questions.translationJa: 会議は予定どおり開催されます。たとえ基調講演者がキャンセルしても、パネル討議は続きます。
questions.explanationJa: キャンセルという強い条件でも続行という結論が変わらないためEven ifです。

questions.prompt: The recruiter has not received a reply. She is checking ------- the candidate accepted another offer.

choices.A: unless
choices.B: provided that
choices.C: whether
choices.D: only if

questions.translationJa: 採用担当者はまだ返事を受け取っていません。候補者が別の内定を受けたかどうか確認しています。
questions.explanationJa: checkの目的語として不明な真偽を表すwhether節が必要です。

questions.prompt: Access to the archive is restricted. Staff may enter ------- a records officer accompanies them.

choices.A: even if
choices.B: only if
choices.C: whether
choices.D: unless

questions.translationJa: 書庫への立入りは制限されています。記録管理担当者が同行する場合に限り、職員は入れます。
questions.explanationJa: 同行が入室に必須である文脈なのでonly ifです。

questions.prompt: The outdoor tour is planned for Friday. It will be canceled ------- the weather service issues a storm warning.

choices.A: even if
choices.B: whether
choices.C: provided that
choices.D: if

questions.translationJa: 屋外ツアーは金曜日の予定です。気象機関が暴風警報を出した場合は中止されます。
questions.explanationJa: 警報発令が中止条件なので通常のifが適切で、unlessでは論理が逆になります。

questions.prompt: The equipment may be borrowed for off-site work, ------- that it is insured for the full replacement value.

choices.A: whether
choices.B: even
choices.C: provided
choices.D: unless

questions.translationJa: 全額の再調達価額で保険を掛けるという条件で、機器を社外業務に借りられます。
questions.explanationJa: 許可に厳格な条件を付けるprovided thatの形です。

questions.prompt: The board has already approved the budget. ------- costs increase slightly, the project will begin in April.

choices.A: Even if
choices.B: Only if
choices.C: Unless
choices.D: Whether

questions.translationJa: 取締役会はすでに予算を承認しています。たとえ費用が多少増えても、プロジェクトは4月に始まります。
questions.explanationJa: 多少の費用増でも開始決定が変わらないためEven ifです。

questions.prompt: The warranty request is incomplete. Please indicate ------- the device was exposed to water.

choices.A: unless
choices.B: only if
choices.C: provided that
choices.D: whether

questions.translationJa: 保証申請が不完全です。機器が水にさらされたかどうかを示してください。
questions.explanationJa: indicateの内容として真偽を答えるwhether節を使います。

questions.prompt: The premium lounge is not open to all passengers. Admission is granted ------- a traveler holds a business-class ticket.

choices.A: even if
choices.B: only if
choices.C: unless
choices.D: whether

questions.translationJa: プレミアムラウンジは全乗客向けではありません。ビジネスクラスの航空券を持つ旅行者に限り入場できます。
questions.explanationJa: 航空券保有が入場の必要条件なのでonly ifです。

questions.prompt: The server normally runs overnight. Do not shut it down ------- the network administrator gives permission.

choices.A: unless
choices.B: even if
choices.C: whether
choices.D: only if

questions.translationJa: サーバーは通常夜通し稼働します。ネットワーク管理者が許可した場合を除き、停止しないでください。
questions.explanationJa: 停止禁止の原則から許可時だけを例外にするunlessです。

questions.prompt: The publisher will accept the revised article, ------- that every quotation is properly cited.

choices.A: whether
choices.B: even
choices.C: unless
choices.D: providing

questions.translationJa: すべての引用を適切に出典表示するという条件で、出版社は改訂記事を受理します。
questions.explanationJa: 受理に付随する厳密な条件をproviding thatで示します。
